business_problem: replace a slow, resource-constrained data lake approach so telemetry, support, and operational data could be analyzed fast enough to improve urban remote-driving operations and customer support.
solution_summary: Vay uses Snowflake, Snowpipe, Amazon S3, and Cortex AI to analyze remote-driving operations and customer interactions across its urban mobility service. Telemetry and live video metadata from Remote Driving Stations, app events, CRM data, and customer support inputs land in Amazon S3 and are ingested into Snowflake through Snowpipe so diverse semi-structured sources can be queried from one engine. Teams use Snowflake’s compute and geospatial capabilities to explore roughly 80 data sources, track demand, and refine routes and vehicle operations in near real time. Vay also applies Cortex AI and AI_TRANSCRIBE to transcribe, summarize, and categorize support calls, helping customer service teams spot issues in the app or vehicles without manual review. The unified platform replaced an error-prone data lake approach and accelerated experimentation.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Holds upstream remote-driving and application data that feeds Vay’s Snowflake environment.

solution_components.name: Snowpipe
solution_components.role: Loads diverse, evolving upstream data into Snowflake with schema-agnostic ingestion.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the central analytics engine for operational, geospatial, and customer-service analysis.

solution_components.name: Cortex AI
solution_components.role: Transcribes, summarizes, and categorizes customer calls so support teams can spot issues and trends faster.

data_flow: Remote Driving Station telemetry, app activity, CRM data, and support-call artifacts land in Amazon S3 and are ingested into Snowflake through Snowpipe. Snowflake powers geospatial and operational analysis, while Cortex AI processes call audio and summaries for customer service and product-improvement workflows.
business_outcome: Vay achieved 12x faster compute across 80 data sources, saved customer service agents more than 300 hours through AI-assisted call analysis, and migrated all workloads to Snowflake in three months.
